UPDATE 2026-11-10 (slice 1, transport and model, best-practice call): lib/editor-crdt/awareness.ts gains a pure peer book (hear, leave, prune on a 20 s TTL, 50-peer cap) and the provider takes an optional `presence` option: each tab broadcasts its own {userId, name, color, selectedNid} on a separate `presence` event on the same private channel (on join, on a 6 s heartbeat, on every selection change, and a `leave` on disconnect), hears the others, and never writes any of it to the document. Tests cover two tabs seeing each other, a selection following, goodbye, TTL, the peer cap, and the document bytes unchanged by presence. Not done: the faces in the top bar and the on-canvas selection outlines (a component in components/builder/presence, wired in the shell), and the probe scripts/probes/builder/BLD-401.mjs that switches this row to cmd. Row stays blocked on those two, not on anything external.

Packet G UI slice: the editor-only presence components render bounded peer faces and non-interactive selection markers from the existing awareness shape and supplied node bounds. Fixtures cover peer expiry, shared selections and invalid geometry. The UI has no CRDT runtime import and no document writes. The parent remains blocked until live shell wiring and its integration probe.

UPDATE 2026-11-11 (slice 2, live wiring): the session forwards the provider's presence option and gains select(nid). EditorCollab joins with presence (who this tab is comes from presenceSelf: the signed-in id, a display name, never the email, and a colour hashed from the id), follows the store's selectedNid and reports peers; the Space builder shows faces in its header and outlines each peer's selected node (components/builder/presence/presence-live.tsx measures only the selected nodes; the Space builder loads the presence UI as its own dynamic chunk only once a peer is heard, so the BLD-101 builder ratchet holds and no visitor pays for it). The canvas route (/pages/canvas?space=<id>) joins with presence too, shows faces above the frame and outlines the demo node a peer is in. The v3 builder top bar reads faces from EditorPeersProvider and draws nothing until a site session provides one (the site builder has no CRDT session yet). Presence never writes the doc; the presence UI imports types only, and the Yjs runtime stays in the allowlisted dynamic chunks. Flag-off (EDITOR_COLLAB / EDITOR_CANVAS off) nothing mounts a session, the peer list is empty and nothing renders. Probe scripts/probes/builder/BLD-401.mjs fails on the prior main and passes here. Not verified: two real browsers side by side (no browser in the build environment); convergence and local-only undo rest on the E0 provider and text-binding tests.
